previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted for post-procedural monitoring following an elective bronchoscopy with tracheal and left mainstem bronchus dilation and tracheostomy exchange due to recurrent tracheobronchomalacia from Ruvalcaba-Myhre-Smith syndrome and relapsing polychondritis. His hospital course was complicated by acute hypercapnic respiratory failure on hospital day 1 due to tracheostomy dislodgment, requiring urgent bronchoscopy and temporary mechanical ventilation. He had a brief episode of asymptomatic atrial flutter, which resolved without intervention. After repeated airway interventions and stabilization, his respiratory status improved, and he was weaned off support. He was discharged home in stable condition with a secure tracheostomy, able to maintain oxygenation on room air during the day and using his home trach mask at night.
